newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia Oct stock turnover hits $704.3 million.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia Oct stock turnover hits $704.3 million.

text.p: Turnover on the Mongolian Stock Exchange was 422.58 billion tugriks ($704.3 million) in October, official statistics said on Friday.
More than two million shares were traded in October while the average earning per share was 131 tugriks, the State Statistics Bulletin said in the first such report on Mongolia's stock market.
A total of 434 stocks were listed on the Mongolian bourse and nearly 155,000 clients had accounts with brokerages at the end of October, the report said.
The exchange also sold 700.61 million tugriks worth of discounted government debt in the month, it said.
